source.name: Government of Kerala Ente Bhoomi ILMS public map
source.operator: Kerala Survey and Land Records Department / NIC Kerala (portal attribution)
source.access: Anonymous public map workflow; no login, payment, or CAPTCHA used.
source.geometryObservation: A bounded 100 m × 100 m GeoJSON response returned native IDs and polygon geometries. Four 50 m quadrant responses had an identical union of IDs and geometries, and the clicked parcel was included. The provider returned a few rows whose polygon geometries do not intersect the requested boxes; single-component multipolygons rule out disconnected parts as the explanation, so consumers must apply exact local geometry intersection filtering. A fresh exact-ID lookup returned the click geometry; a synthetic absent ID returned no records.

exportConfig.scope: 100 m × 100 m center window plus four 50 m quadrants; local only

viewerFlow.privacy: No session tokens/cookies, account data, parcel owner/person attributes, or full geometry were written. Only public selector names, location codes, endpoint paths, and status evidence are retained.

spatialIntersectionAudit.method: @turf/turf booleanIntersects against EPSG:32643 bbox polygons, using each returned unique feature geometry; topology is CRS-independent for these planar intersections.
spatialIntersectionAudit.explanation: The provider returned a small number of rows whose actual polygon does not intersect a requested box. Those features are single-component multipolygons, so disconnected parts do not explain the extras. Most have envelopes overlapping the box while polygon boundaries do not, consistent with a coarse envelope/candidate filter; one Kozhikode candidate envelope misses by about 1 cm. The exact adapter intersection filter should discard them. Per-quadrant raw ID lists were not persisted, so the per-box counts compare provider raw response counts with geometry intersections over the proven-identical union.

clickInfo.responseShape: JSON array with one parcel feature; retained sample contains only parcel_gid, survey_no, block_no and geometry WKT.

officialSelection.scope: Published candidate in Thiruvananthapuram taluk; partial urban-area candidate only. The WUP-point Sasthamangalam candidate from earlier work is outside the currently published subset; this replacement was not proved to contain the WUP point.
officialSelection.candidateScope: One 100 m × 100 m window around a sample parcel in published Kudappanakunnu urban locality. The sample parcel is 3.47 km from the WUP target point and does not contain it. The earlier Sasthamangalam candidate at the WUP location was outside the published subset. This is not a complete village or city inventory.

validation.distanceMethod: Euclidean distance in EPSG:32643 between the viewer click coordinate and the projected WUP target point

boundedGeometryValidation.projection: EPSG:32643 to EPSG:4326 using backend package proj4 2.22.0, rounded to 1e-8 degrees

blocker: This establishes a bounded local retrieval path and exact-ID lookup only. The small viewport responses include a few non-intersecting candidate geometries, so exact local filtering is required. Complete village extent, full city coverage, registry status, and WUP target coverage remain unproven.
nextStep: Use the verified location-specific GeoJSON viewport and exact-ID protocol only with strict bounds, response caps, geometry validation, and exact local footprint filtering. Do not treat this local sample as full village or city coverage.

viewerConfiguredFgbExport.requestBody: Not present in the selected viewer initdata/output_layers. Official bundled map library’s BHUNAKSHA_FGB loader requires source_parms.input; I did not guess a payload or submit an incomplete export.
viewerConfiguredFgbExport.libraryBehavior: For configured BHUNAKSHA_FGB layers, POSTs source_parms.input as JSON; the selected village config exposed top-level fgb_url but no BHUNAKSHA_FGB output layer or input body.

historicalAttempts.viewerConfiguredFgbOutcome: No source_parms.input was exposed in selected viewer initdata; no FGB request body was guessed or submitted. A separate documented same-publisher GeoJSON viewport request path was subsequently verified.
